svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut one 592 mm length of 40 x 40 x 4 angle; deburr the ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One leg stands upright against the lug and the wall bracket; the other

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: lies flat along the top, pointing away from the lug.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Upright leg: four 11 mm holes, 18 mm up from its lower edge:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: at the mast end 10 and 37 mm from the end;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: at the wall end 13 and 40 mm from the end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill the mast-end pair through the lug together if you can.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Paint cut ends and holes with zinc-rich paint.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: two M10 bolts to the mast lug, two to the wall bracket, nuts on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the stay side. Two bolts at each end stop the mast swinging along

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the wall; the stay is horizontal and square to the wall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: hole pairs 27 mm apart and 552 mm between the pairs.
